fields.description: Issue includes editorials and local commentary on Coral Gables city politics and the resignation of public safety director "Pop" Lehman; a satirical piece about legislating hurricanes and controlling hurricane reporting (mentioning Weatherman Gray); discussion of school cafeteria policies and children’s beverages citing Senator Royal S. Copeland; recurring columns ("Round the Town") with local anecdotes including Jim Allison’s estate; criticism of justice-of-the-peace offices, city infrastructure and traffic safety, and calls for improvements to parks and public works. Additional coverage addresses milk sanitation and proposals for certified/pasteurized milk, city food ordinances, police and fire department management, and Prohibition-era liquor supply and pricing; includes society column items and local advertisements.
